items.title: Don't Waste Your Life || Learn English Through Motivation 🔥 || Graded Reader || Listening Practice✅️
items.introEn: This video teaches you how to stop wasting time and start working on your dreams. It gives you simple steps to change your life, work hard, and stop making excuses.

items.title: My Passion
items.introEn: This story is about my passion for drones, digital making, and AI learning. I want to learn new tools, create meaningful things, and share my joy with other people.

items.title: The Middle East's Greatest Contributions
items.introEn: This story explains how the Middle East helped shape human civilization through farming, writing, religion, trade, and knowledge from ancient times to the modern world.

items.title: Here's Why Your Next Cup of Coffee Will Cost $25
items.introEn: This lesson explores the complex journey of coffee from the farm to your cup, explaining why the low prices we pay today do not reflect the difficult work required to produce it.

items.title: How the Swiss Protected Hitler's Gold
items.introEn: This lesson explores the dark history of Swiss banks during World War II, focusing on how their policy of neutrality allowed them to profit from Nazi-looted gold and ignore humanitarian atrocities.

items.title: KFC Success Story
items.introEn: This story introduces the life of Colonel Harland Sanders, showing how he overcame many failures and challenges to build the global brand KFC through persistence and belief in himself.

items.title: Michael Dell: The Father of the PC Industry
items.introEn: This story explores how Michael Dell transformed the computer industry by launching a successful direct-selling business from his dorm room and building it into a global powerhouse.

items.title: The Rise of Airbnb: From Airbeds to Billions
items.introEn: This story explores how the founders of Airbnb turned a desperate need for rent money into a multi-billion dollar company by using creativity and persistence during a global economic crisis.

items.title: The War of Dirty Tricks: How Richard Branson Defeated British Airways
items.introEn: This story explores how Richard Branson turned a canceled flight into the launch of Virgin Atlantic and describes his fierce battle against British Airways' unfair attempts to destroy his company.

items.title: Crisis in Middle East
items.introEn: This text explains the recent crisis in the Middle East, including changes in Syria and Yemen, conflict involving Israel, internal unrest in Iran, a major escalation in February 2026, Iran's retaliation, and the long path toward peace.

items.title: Learn English With Story 🔥 The Farmer Who Built a Business | Level 3 Listening  || Graded Reader 📚
items.introEn: This story follows the journey of Raj, a dedicated farmer who dares to look beyond the hardships of his daily routine to pursue a vision of greater success, proving that determination and hope can bridge the gap between humble beginnings and a life of possibility.

items.title: The Girl Who Never Give Up
items.introEn: This story follows Maya, a quiet girl from a small town who loves drawing but is afraid to speak openly about her dream of becoming an artist.

items.title: The Man Who Lost Everything
items.introEn: This graded story follows Daniel Carter, a successful business owner who loses everything he built and learns courage, family, and a new beginning.
